name: Oltenia de Sub Munte
intro: A belt of forested foothills and limestone ridges beneath the Southern Carpathians, where beech forest, karst gorges and a scatter of small spa towns and mountain villages meet. The portfolio here works through rural culture, ecosystem protection and heritage-led regeneration — most visibly through the Junior Ranger conservation education programme, the Pietrari Participation Library, and Govora Heritage Lab's regeneration of a declining spa town.
shortNarrative: Oltenia de sub Munte, led by Kogayon Association, weaves together rural culture, ecosystem restoration and heritage-led regeneration in the forested foothills of Romania's Southern Carpathians. The portfolio grows through education, community ownership and place-based policy, turning small mountain villages and spa towns into living laboratories for bioregional change.

criticalShifts.name: Culture and heritage
criticalShifts.shift: Culture thrives as a living force through which communities keep traditions alive, and tell new stories about their place and future
criticalShifts.leveragePoint: Supporting cultural programmes, events, and heritage initiatives that bring people together and tell new stories about place
criticalShifts.systemicBarrier: The role of culture in sustaining community life is undervalued, whether through traditional crafts and heritage or through contemporary arts and storytelling; as rural areas depopulate and cultural life thins, communities lose the shared narratives that give places meaning

criticalShifts.name: Education and knowledge
criticalShifts.shift: Knowledge systems actively develop and disseminate regenerative practice, equipping people with the mindsets, skills, and tools to regenerate their place
criticalShifts.leveragePoint: Building knowledge networks, curricula, and research programmes for regenerative practice
criticalShifts.systemicBarrier: Regenerative approaches to land, ecology, and economy are not embedded in mainstream education or research; practitioners lack access to the knowledge, tools, and peer networks needed to innovate and scale

criticalShifts.name: Ecosystems and biodiversity
criticalShifts.shift: Ecosystem integrity is restored at landscape scale, with healthy soils, water, and biodiversity as the foundation for all land use and community resilience
criticalShifts.leveragePoint: Developing landscape-scale holistic ecosystem restoration and conservation programmes
criticalShifts.systemicBarrier: Ecosystems are under sustained pressure from industrial land use, fragmentation, and pollution, with biodiversity in steep decline; restoration efforts remain fragmented, underfunded, and disconnected from the needs of local communities

criticalShifts.name: Food and agriculture
criticalShifts.shift: Regenerative agriculture becomes the norm, restoring ecological health and enabling diverse, resilient farming livelihoods
criticalShifts.leveragePoint: Developing viable models for regenerative farming and food systems
criticalShifts.systemicBarrier: Large-scale industrial farming drives water and air pollution, soil degradation, and biodiversity loss; small-scale farmers often perpetuate similar degrading practices for lack of the knowledge, financing, and support needed to transition

criticalShifts.name: Value chains and economic development
criticalShifts.shift: Regional economies diversify and add value locally, with business models that reward regenerative practice and keep value circulating in place
criticalShifts.leveragePoint: Developing new business models and short supply chains that capture more value from local assets
criticalShifts.systemicBarrier: Regional economies remain locked in low-value extraction, raw materials and products leave without processing or transformation, generating little local income; new business models remain underdeveloped

criticalShifts.name: Finance and ownership
criticalShifts.shift: Capital flows toward regeneration; land and assets are governed in the long-term interest of communities and ecosystems
criticalShifts.leveragePoint: Co-creating place-based financing mechanisms and community ownership models
criticalShifts.systemicBarrier: Regenerative projects lack access to appropriate financing; land, housing, and productive assets have become unaffordable due to financialisation and concentrated ownership

criticalShifts.name: Policy and advocacy
criticalShifts.shift: Policy frameworks at all levels are aligned with regenerative goals and responsive to local needs
criticalShifts.leveragePoint: Developing policy engagement formats that connect local practice to systemic change
criticalShifts.systemicBarrier: Policies at EU, national, and local levels are fragmented, contradictory, and poorly connected to on-the-ground realities, leaving communities without a coherent enabling framework for regeneration

systemicInnovations.name: Ranger Junior
systemicInnovations.description: Kogayon environmental education programme engaging children and young people with mountain ecosystems through hands-on conservation activities and outdoor learning.

systemicInnovations.name: Pietrari Library
systemicInnovations.description: Rural library transformed into participation infrastructure, hosting workshops, cultural events and local knowledge-sharing in the village of Pietrari.

systemicInnovations.name: Govora Heritage Lab
systemicInnovations.description: Heritage lab turning Govora's spa heritage into community-rooted regeneration through culture, public space and participatory place-making.

systemicInnovations.name: Kogayon Association
systemicInnovations.description: Romanian association protecting Oltenia's natural and cultural heritage through education, advocacy and community-based conservation programmes.

systemicInnovations.name: The Network of Urban Nature
systemicInnovations.description: Romanian civil society network protecting urban nature through advocacy, mapping and collaborative green-space stewardship in cities.

systemicInnovations.name: Eco Ruralis
systemicInnovations.description: National association of peasants and organic farmers promoting agroecology, seed sovereignty and short food chains across Romania.

systemicInnovations.name: Green Belt of Bucharest
systemicInnovations.description: Citizen-led green belt initiative envisioning a resilient ecological corridor around Bucharest through reforestation, wetlands and community land care.

systemicInnovations.name: ALPA
systemicInnovations.description: Land for Life organisation protecting farmland and rural livelihoods in Țara Călatei through community ownership and regenerative agriculture.
